diffuseAlbedo.source: Palette.json: accent.verde-antico realMaterial (serpentine breccia, Larissa, Thessaly)
diffuseAlbedo.note: The dark green serpentine matrix with its pale calcite and dark clasts, averaged over a face; read from trade photographs until a specimen is measured.

refractiveIndex.source: Palette.json: accent.verde-antico realMaterial (serpentine breccia, Larissa, Thessaly)
refractiveIndex.note: Antigorite serpentine, the matrix, has indices near 1.56 to 1.57; the calcite clasts are near 1.60. No measurement of the stone was read.

porosity.source: Palette.json: accent.verde-antico realMaterial (serpentine breccia, Larissa, Thessaly)
porosity.note: A dense serpentinite breccia, open porosity a few tenths of a per cent; no measured value was read.

wettingDepth.source: Palette.json: accent.verde-antico realMaterial (serpentine breccia, Larissa, Thessaly)
wettingDepth.note: As the Crema Marfil: a dense stone wets only its outer millimetre.

grain.source: Palette.json: accent.verde-antico realMaterial (serpentine breccia, Larissa, Thessaly)
grain.note: A fine serpentine matrix; its clasts are its visible structure.

bed.source: Palette.json: accent.verde-antico realMaterial (serpentine breccia, Larissa, Thessaly)
bed.note: The breccia's clasts, a first size read from trade photographs.

bedAspect.source: Palette.json: accent.verde-antico realMaterial (serpentine breccia, Larissa, Thessaly)
bedAspect.note: A breccia's clasts lie every way: no drawn-out direction.

hurst.source: Candela et al. 2012, Journal of Geophysical Research 117, B08409 (fault surfaces, 0.6 to 0.8; cited in Stone.ush)
hurst.note: The middle of the range measured on rock surfaces, as the travertine's.

toneSpread.source: Palette.json: accent.verde-antico realMaterial (serpentine breccia, Larissa, Thessaly)
toneSpread.note: White calcite and near-black clasts in a dark green matrix: the widest tonal spread of the Hall's stones.

roughnessSpread.source: Workings/honed.json: unverified surface.microRoughness (no filtered roughness read)
roughnessSpread.note: A first half-range of ln(roughness) across a worked face, as the travertine's.
